Name: Custom Wedding Ceremony
Author: AirynS
Description:
[size=3]Custom Wedding Ceremony changes the default wedding ceremony to take place in one of seven new locations, adds more decorative elements, and completely revamps Lewis's speech for something heartfelt and fulfilling on your special day! Your fiance's family will also sit in the front row, with one person giving a short speech during the ceremony.

[/size][size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size][size=3]:
Simply extract the "[CP] Custom Wedding Ceremony" folder and drop it in your Mods folder.

[/size][size=3]
[/size][b][size=5]Configuration:[/size][/b]
CWC has two options:

[b]Wedding Venue[/b]. Choose where you'd like to hold your wedding.
[list]
[*][b]Beach[/b]. The ceremony will be held on the Pelican Town beach near Elliott's house
[*][b]Town[/b]. This is the default town square location but with all other improved features
[*][b]Community Centre[/b]. The ceremony will be held in front of the Community Centre.
[*][b]Secret Woods[/b]. The ceremony will be held in a quiet grove.
[*][b]Desert[/b]. The ceremony will be held in a Calico Desert oasis.
[*][b]Meadow[/b]. The ceremony will be held in the Flower Dance forest meadow.
[*][b]River[/b]. The ceremony will be held next to a peaceful river in Cindersap Forest.
[/list][b]MultiplayerWedding. [/b]Enables a multiplayer-specific version of the wedding event. Only enable this if you are marrying another player! If you are marrying an NPC in multiplayer, you do not need to enable this option.

[size=5][b]Compatibility:[/b][/size]
CWC is compatible with custom NPC spouses as long as they don't have their own custom wedding event, such as Hat Mouse Lacey - nothing will clash, but the NPC's wedding event will take priority over CWC. Only vanilla spouses will have the family speech though. I will not be adding specific compatibility for custom NPCs, but mod authors are welcome to create a version for them using my code as a base as long as my original mod is a requirement.

The following mods have compatibility for their NPCs attending the farmer's wedding:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9600]Visit Mount Vapius [/url]﻿by Lumisteria (for Adelaide, Celestine, and Maddy)
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18177]Hat Mouse Lacey [/url]﻿by ichortower
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village [/url]﻿by Rafseazz (only if marrying a RSV NPC)
[/list]
Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8146]Platonic Partners and Friendships[/url]﻿! CWC is written to be heartfelt but not explicitly romantic, and it will adapt to your PPAF relationships and change its text to suit a commitment ceremony where needed.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23020]Seasonal Wedding Arch[/url]!

Compatibility with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27081]Jewish Chuppah - Wedding Arch [/url]﻿is coming soon!

For additional synergy (as seen in the mod screenshots), [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17059]Diverse Stardew Valley [/url]﻿adds formal outfits for all wedding guests. DSV's chuppah for Jewish Elliott and Alex will also apply!

Untested with PolyamorySweet but if it is not compatible, I will not support it. Other future polyamory mods will be considered.

Maps are based on the vanilla maps. They will not clash with mods that change vanilla maps but also will not match any changes made. This includes SVE. [b]I will not include specific compatibility with SVE and comments asking about it will be deleted.

KNOWN ISSUE: [/b]Occasionally the farmer will stand one tile further back from their spouse. This is a vanilla bug that affects the default wedding ceremony on occasion as well, and it apparently happens at random so I'm unable to do anything about it. If your wedding starts and the farmer is not aligned with their spouse, you can try force-quitting and reloading the day. Changing the venue in the config settings also seems to sometimes have an effect.
